mentions.name: NeXTBus experimentation board
mentions.description: An experimentation board for the NeXTBus, built to better understand the nuances between NeXT's and Apple's NuBus implementations; designed via KiCAD PCB generation with MCPs.
mentions.source_excerpt: NeXTBus experimentation board (not that I'll ever use it, but I'll be darned if I don't understand the nuances between NeXT and Apple's NuBUS implementations better now)
